description: Béthune - Consommation/Production d’énergie (source ENEDIS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Béthune. Data on energy production/consumption in the territory of Bethune. Coverage: Ville de Béthune. The portal shows the English title as "Béthune — Consumption/Energy production (source ENEDIS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Béthune. Its keywords include production-electrique, production, electricite, energies, enedis, consommation. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XLS, CSV. The listing shows 2019-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
